categories.name: Scientific correctness, claim discipline & leakage safety

categories.name: Alignment with SIH documentation and research corpus
categories.verification_details: Strict alignment with SIH Problem Statement #1736 ('Know When Forecasts May Fail') and meteorological literature. Traceability to domain specifications, operational issue-time constraints, and physical units (K, Pa, m/s).
